endpoint horses.list {
  route: GET "/horses"
  output: [Horse]
}

endpoint horses.get {
  route: GET "/horses/[id]"
  output: Horse
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint horses.create {
  route: POST "/horses"
  input: { name: string(max 60), breed: Breed, age: int(min 1, max 40), bio: string(max 280) }
  output: Horse
  errors: invalid_input
}

endpoint horses.update {
  route: PATCH "/horses/[id]"
  input: { name: string(max 60), breed: Breed, age: int(min 1, max 40), bio: string(max 280) } (all optional)
  output: Horse
  errors: not_found, invalid_input
}

endpoint horses.delete {
  route: DELETE "/horses/[id]"
  errors: not_found, in_use
}

endpoint horses.swipes {
  route: GET "/horses/[id]/swipes"
  output: [Swipe]
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint horses.swiped_by {
  route: GET "/horses/[id]/swiped_by"
  output: [Swipe]
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint horses.first_matches {
  route: GET "/horses/[id]/first_matches"
  output: [Match]
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint horses.second_matches {
  route: GET "/horses/[id]/second_matches"
  output: [Match]
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint swipes.list {
  route: GET "/swipes"
  output: [Swipe]
}

endpoint swipes.create {
  route: POST "/swipes"
  input: { liked: bool, horse_id: Horse.id, target_id: Horse.id }
  output: Swipe
  errors: invalid_input
}

endpoint matches.list {
  route: GET "/matches"
  output: [Match]
}

endpoint matches.get {
  route: GET "/matches/[id]"
  output: Match
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint swipe {
  route: POST "/swipe"
  input: { horse: Horse, target: Horse, liked: bool }
  output: Swipe
  errors: invalid_input, same_horse, already_swiped
  steps: record_swipe, match_if_mutual
}
